Quem sou eu

Creative professional whose path runs from Brazil's biggest YouTube channel (KondZilla) to partner and content leadership at a growing startup. Track record of 300+ paid ads, 100+ podcast episodes, 70+ music videos, social media content, plus cinematography and color on a fiction short film. Content production driven by AI, connected to marketing goals, mainly through YouTube videos and Instagram short-form content.
